svg.title: The encoder is a property of the model
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “The encoder is a property of the model” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. Three columns: paired raw and scaled accuracy bars showing KNN gaining 35.9 points and a boosted tree gaining nothing from standardising, a forty-level category fanning into one-hot, ordinal and target encodings with logistic regression gaining 9.77 AUC points from one-hot while HistGB gains 0.23, and three target-encoding schemes of which the 0.7471 full-dataset version and the 0.6234 reused-fold version are struck out leaving out-of-fold at 0.6423.
svg.text: The encoder is a property of the model
